title: Manager, Analog Design
description:
**Job Description**

  

Looking for a 10\+ years experienced Engineering Manager with in\-depth understanding of Analog concepts, experience of design of complex Analog I/Ps \& sub\-blocks, integrating I/Ps and sub systems and ownership, experience of fully owning smaller ICs (Point of loads, Single Converters) and owning major I/Ps in large PMICs, to join the 2\.6B$ Power Business Unit. The candidate will get to work on a wide range of exciting products such as PMICs, Linear and Switching DC\-DC converters powering the next generation of Renesas processors. This is an early\-stage growth opportunity where in the candidate will get to learn, build and over time contribute and influence the charter for Renesas’s massive Power product portfolio.


Essential Functions:

* Must be proficient in designing and owning complex I/Ps like \+ve/\-ve Charge Pumps, Buck Converters, Source\-Sink LDOs, Ultra\-low power Oscillators (including Relaxation type), Temperature Sensor, Current Sense, SAR ADCs, Protection (Thermal, Under\-Voltage, Over\-Voltage, Over Current etc) and analog blocks including Bandgap references, V2I, Analog Buffers, Op\-Amps, Comparators, High speed level shifters etc.
* Must have in\-depth Understanding of and should be able to implement \& compensate the Control Loops, Analog feedback loops and should know trade\-offs between various compensation strategies.
* Should be able to build/support Block level spec break down from Top level chip requirements and independently own, design complete switching converter e.g. Buck, Boost, Buck\-Boost etc and LDOs. Must be able to do block level error budgeting depending on the block requirements.
* Must be aware of relative differences of various control loop architectures (Constant Freq, Constant ON/OFF Time, Current mode etc) and decide/implement the best option to meet converter level performance specifications and other system requirements.
* Must be able to bring in innovative ideas to improve designs to meet challenging specifications.
* Should have in\-depth knowledge of Analog layouts and be able to work closely with layout lead from floor planning till Chip Top completion and verification and do trade\-offs based on desired performance
* Must be conversant with the standard design, extraction and simulation flows \& tools, speed, convergence, accuracy trade\-offs and should be able to optimize setups based on Pre/Post (with/without) Parasitic using simulator options, debug and navigate through tool related challenges.
* Should be able to setup design flows and methodologies including checklists, reviews to ensure quality designs and take them all the way to Silicon success.
* Should be able to mentor Freshers and Junior engineers for upscaling their technical skills as well as other skills needed for better efficacy.
* Should have experience of end\-to\-end IC development flow, Silicon debugs, and taking ICs to production
* Should be able to lead/manage a small group of Engineers and navigate through all stages of IC development while handling and mitigating challenges, ensuring high quality silicon while adhering to the schedules based on business needs.
* Should have in\-depth understanding of ESD, LU and other IC level issues and be able to define protection for the I/O ring for the IC

 **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering
* 10\+ years in Analog Circuit Design, minimum 2 years of managerial experience.
* Solid understanding and design experience of complex analog designs with full ownership.
* Chip design, Verification, Silicon validation, debugs, Qual support and taking ICs to production.
* Must be a technical leader and natural team player, mentor and should strive towards fostering a highly creative and productive working environment

 **Company Description**

  

Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.


Renesas employs roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what’s next in electronics and the world.

 **Additional Information**

  

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose ‘**To Make Our Lives Easier**.’ As the industry’s leading expert in embedded processing with unmatched quality and system\-level know\-how, we have evolved to provide scalable and comprehensive semiconductor solutions for automotive, industrial, infrastructure, and IoT industries based on the broadest product portfolio, including High Performance Computing, Embedded Processing, Analog \& Connectivity, and Power.  

  

With a diverse team of over 21,000 professionals in more than 30 countries, we continue to expand our boundaries to offer enhanced user experiences through digitalization and usher into a new era of innovation. We design and develop sustainable, power\-efficient solutions today that help people and communities thrive tomorrow, ‘**To Make Our Lives Easier**.’  

  

At Renesas, you can:

* **Launch and advance your career** in technical and business roles across four Product Groups and various corporate functions. You will have the opportunities to explore our hardware and software capabilities and try new things.
* **Make a real impact** by developing innovative products and solutions to meet our global customers' evolving needs and help make people’s lives easier, safe and secure.
* **Maximize your performance and wellbeing** in our flexible and inclusive work environment. Our people\-first culture and global support system, including the remote work option and Employee Resource Groups, will help you excel from the first day.


Are you ready to own your success and make your mark?


Join Renesas. Let’s **Shape the Future** together.


Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our **Diversity \& Inclusion Statement**.


We have adopted a hybrid model that gives employees the ability to work remotely two days a week while ensuring that we come together as a team in the office the rest of the time. The designated in\-office days are Tuesday through Thursday for innovation, collaboration and continuous learning.

**Role Objective**

We are seeking a detail\-oriented and disciplined **Quality Control Executive** to join our manufacturing facility in Ranihati. This role is primarily focused on ensuring that all raw materials and finished plastic products meet stringent industry standards and client specifications. As a fresh graduate, you will be mentored to handle testing equipment and maintain rigorous quality documentation.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **In\-Process Inspection:** Conduct regular quality checks at various stages of the production line to identify defects or deviations early.

* **Non\-Conformance Management:** Identify rejected materials, segregate them, and report root causes to the Production Manager.
* **Calibration:** Assist in the periodic calibration of lab instruments and weighing scales.

**Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Education:** Graduate/Diploma from **CIPET** (DPT, DPMT, or PGD\-PPT) is highly preferred.
* **Technical Knowledge:** Basic understanding of polymer processing, plastic testing standards (ASTM/ISO), and material properties.
* **Soft Skills:** Strong observational skills, integrity, and the ability to work in a fast\-paced industrial environment.

**MECHANICAL ENGINEER – JOB DESCRIPTION**

Location: Surat

Department: Production

Reports To: Production Manager / Production Head

Experience: 0–1 Year

Job Type: Full\-time

JOB SUMMARY

We are seeking a highly motivated and technically proficient Mechanical Engineer for our Textile Printing Machine Manufacturing Division. The role involves supporting end\-to\-end production operations, including machine assembly, fabrication coordination, production planning, process monitoring, quality assurance, and continuous improvement initiatives. The role demands a strong technical understanding of industrial machine manufacturing, mechanical systems, and structured production execution.

The ideal candidate should possess sound engineering fundamentals, strong analytical capabilities, and the ability to perform effectively in a high\-precision manufacturing environment.

KEY ROLES \& RESPONSIBILITIES

* Execute and monitor day\-to\-day production activities related to the manufacturing and assembly of textile printing machinery in accordance with approved production plans.
* Coordinate the assembly of Rotary Printing Machines, Flatbed Printing Machines, Laser Engraving Systems, and Digital Textile Printers while ensuring adherence to engineering specifications and quality benchmarks.
* Supervise fabrication, machining, fitting, alignment, and final assembly processes to ensure dimensional accuracy, functional reliability, and production efficiency.
* Review mechanical drawings, General Arrangement (GA) drawings, Bill of Materials (BOM), assembly instructions, and production schedules prior to execution.
* Ensure optimum utilization of manpower, machinery, tools, and production resources to achieve targeted output and timely project completion.
* Identify and resolve mechanical assembly challenges including fitment deviations, alignment discrepancies, vibration issues, and performance\-related concerns during production stages.
* Coordinate closely with Design, Electrical, Fabrication, Stores, Procurement, and Quality departments to ensure seamless workflow and production continuity.
* Conduct in\-process inspections and monitor compliance with established manufacturing standards and quality parameters.
* Support machine testing, dry trials, performance validation, and final inspection activities prior to machine dispatch.
* Maintain accurate production documentation including daily production reports, job progress status, rejection analysis, downtime records, and productivity reports.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives aimed at reducing rework and improving manufacturing efficiency.
* Ensure strict adherence to shop floor safety practices, 5S implementation, and company SOPs.

KEY SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

* Strong understanding of industrial machine manufacturing processes, fabrication methodologies, and precision assembly systems.
* Sound knowledge of textile printing machine architecture, including Rotary Printing Systems, Flatbed Machines, Laser Engraving Equipment, and Digital Textile Printing Solutions.
* Proficiency in interpreting mechanical drawings, fabrication layouts, assembly drawings, GA drawings, and Bill of Materials (BOM).
* Working knowledge of mechanical transmission systems, including shafts, bearings, rollers, gear assemblies, gearboxes, pneumatic systems, and motion transfer mechanisms.
* Familiarity with production planning, process flow optimisation, machine trial procedures, and in\-process quality assurance practices.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills for resolving production bottlenecks and mechanical non\-conformities.
* Basic proficiency in AutoCAD and production documentation systems will be considered an added advantage.
* Effective coordination and communication skills for managing cross\-functional production activities and technical discussions.
* Strong discipline in reporting, execution, and shop floor supervision within a structured manufacturing environment.
* Ability to perform under production deadlines while maintaining quality, safety, and operational excellence.

QUALIFICATIONS

* Education: Diploma or Degree in Mechanical Engineering

description:

* Build, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines using Databricks/Python.

* Integrate data from multiple sources and manage data lakes and warehouses.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve issues related to data pipelines and data processing.

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems or similar.

* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) and data storage solutions.
* Understanding of data governance, data security, and standard methodologies. Knowledge and experience in statistical methods, data mining, and Machine Learning tools and techniques.
* Maintain knowledge of emerging trends and successfully implement this knowledge to educate collaborators of opportunities to provide data analytics solutions that support and drive the business.
* Excellent communication skills, ability to work remotely, and lead on projects independently.
* Flexibility to work with collaborators spread across different time zones. Self\-starter who can balance multiple tasks and priorities.


 NVIDIA is recognized as one of the technology industry’s most attractive employers. We are established as the ‘AI Computing Company’. Our GPUs power gaming, Deep Learning frameworks, accelerated analytics, big data, modern data centers, and autonomous vehicles. We share a mission to transform graphics for work and play. Our technology impacts video game creation, film production, space exploration, medicine, computational finance, and automotive innovation. We have just begun to unlock what our technology can achieve.

We are actively seeking an experienced HR Manager who exhibits a deep understanding of HR functions within the sales industry. This role is critical in ensuring that our hiring processes align with the strategic goals of the company, particularly in recruiting customer relationship managers and vendor relationship managers who can drive performance and meet business targets.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
HR Managers in India and the USA oversee talent acquisition, compensation, employee relations, and compliance, but they operate within different cultural and legal frameworks. Indian HR often focuses on hierarchy, statutory compliance (PF/ESI), and high\-touch employee engagement. US HR prioritizes individual performance, rapid recruitment, data\-driven decisions, and strict federal/state labor law compliance.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities (Common \& Region\-Specific):
 


* Recruitment \& Talent Management: US roles often focus on speed, diversity, and ATS utilization. India roles may involve rigorous multi\-round, long\-term talent acquisition.
* Compliance \& Law: Indian HR requires deep knowledge of complex labor laws, statutory, and compliance, often at a granular level. US HR focuses on EEO, FLSA, FMLA, and state\-specific regulations.
* Employee Relations \& Culture: India's approach is often communal, dealing with strong employee engagement programs and unions, while the US is more task\-oriented and individualistic.
* Performance Management: Both oversee salary reviews and, performance appraisals, but the US often utilizes 360\-degree feedback more frequently.



 Comparison of Experience:
 


* India: Experience highlights managing large\-scale staffing, statutory compliance audits, and high\-touch employee engagement/welfare initiatives.
* USA: Experience focuses on strategic business partnering, HRIS proficiency (e.g., Workday), performance metrics (KPIs), and specialized benefits management.



 Sample Experience Description (Summary):
 


* "Results\-driven HR professional with 5 to 8 years of experience managing full\-cycle HR operations across India and the US. Skilled in aligning HR strategies with business goals, reducing turnover by \[Y]%, and ensuring compliance with local, state, and federal labor laws. Proficient in talent acquisition, performance management, and HRIS (Workday/ADP), with a focus on fostering a high\-performance culture."

title: HR Generalist
description:
About the Role

Pisteyo is growing, and the team behind that growth needs a builder. We are looking for an HR Generalist whose primary focus is recruitment across our US and India operations, with broader people operations responsibilities as the function matures. You will own the hiring engine end to end, from sourcing strong candidates to closing them, and help us scale a workforce that delivers measurable client outcomes.

What You Will Do

**Recruitment (primary focus, \~70%)**

* Own full\-cycle recruiting for technical and consulting roles across the US and India.
* Build and run sourcing strategies on LinkedIn, job boards, referral networks, and direct outreach.
* Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, screening rubrics, and interview loops.
* Conduct first\-round screens and coordinate panel interviews across time zones.
* Manage the candidate experience from first touch to offer acceptance.
* Track funnel metrics (time to hire, source quality, conversion rates) and report to leadership.
* Negotiate offers, handle reference checks, and close hires.

**HR Generalist (secondary, \~30%)**

* Support onboarding for new hires in both regions.
* Maintain employee records, contracts, and basic compliance for US and India entities.
* Help administer benefits, PTO tracking, and routine employee questions.
* Support performance review cycles and employee engagement initiatives.
* Coordinate with external payroll and compliance partners as needed.

What We Are Looking For

* 4 to 7 years of HR or recruiting experience, with at least 2 years owning full\-cycle technical recruitment.
* Direct experience hiring across US and India markets, including familiarity with both labor frameworks.
* Strong sourcing instincts. You can find candidates who are not actively looking.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication.
* Comfortable working asynchronously and overlapping at least 4 hours with US Eastern or Pacific time.
* Experience with an ATS (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, or similar) and standard sourcing tools.
* Calm, organized, and candidate\-first. You treat hiring like a craft, not a checklist.

Nice to Have

* Experience hiring for consulting, AI, or technology services firms.
* Familiarity with Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Business Central, Magento, or Stripe ecosystems (helpful for screening technical candidates).
* Prior experience setting up or scaling an HR function at a growing firm.
* Working knowledge of US contractor vs. employee classifications and India statutory compliance basics.

Why Pisteyo

We are a management consulting firm built by operators. We help organizations turn AI into measurable operational leverage, and we are building a team that reflects that same standard internally. You will have real ownership, a direct line to leadership, and the chance to shape how Pisteyo grows.

**To apply:** Send a short note explaining a hire you are proud of, along with your resume.

title: Graduate Engineer Trainee
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.


We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!


Job Description


**Designation** \- Graduate Engineer Trainee


**City\-** Pune, India


As a Graduate Engineer Trainee at **Rockwell Automation,** you will develop your technical experience approaching a problem from different angles, analysing pros and cons of different solutions, while contributing to real\-world industrial automation projects. You will work in the Business Operations pillar and work on all the workstreams of the pillar like roadmap features, customer success features, technical debt and product health issues reported by the customer.


You will report to the Manager\- Software Engineering, Application Delivery and have a hybrid schedule working in Pune, India.


**Your Responsibilities:**

* Analyse, design software programmes for software enhancements and new products.
* Use current programming language (MS stack) and technologies, writing code, completing programming, and performing testing and debugging of applications.
* Follow the process of Agile and using all the tools that are used during the development cycle.
* Complete documentation and procedures for installation and maintenance.
* May work with users to define system requirements or necessary modifications.
* Personal and delivery; ability to establish and meet milestones and deadlines with our requirements and the process of translating them into well\-engineered and integrated technical solutions

**The Essentials \- You Will Have:**

* Degree in Computer Science and IT or related
* CGPA for 7\.0 and above
* Fresher passed out in 2025\-2026 with 0\-1 year of experience
* We will prefer students who have completed the CDAC course.
* Hands\-on experience with SQL such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, or other relational database software
* Hands\-on experience with Object\-oriented programming such as C\#
* 0\-1 year of experience in the following web frameworks such as ASP.NET , ASP, node.js
* Database design/data modelling experience and performance tuning
* Experience in web development including HTML, CSS, JavaScript
* Experience with version control systems such as Git, Subversion
* Solve business problems, thoughtful in learning new things and having good work attitude and ethics
* Commit to meeting customer service metrics, Service level agreements
* Collaborate with partner teams, peers, and managers
* Status reporting within their teams
* Effective in both individual and team\-based work settings
* Work with diverse and cross\-cultural teams
* Stay informed about relevant technology trends and developments
* We authorise only applicants who are authorised to work in India to apply for job openings based in India.

**The Preferred \- You Might Also Have:**

* Experience with Azure DevOps
* Usage of tools like Jira, Confluence
* Usage of any AI tools like Git hub, Copilot.
* Familiarity with Rockwell Automation platforms.
* Knowledge of industrial automation, control systems or engineering fundamentals.
* Hands\-on project or internship experience in automation, robotics, or industrial systems.
* Exposure in deploying code in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud environments.

**What We Offer:**

Our benefits package includes …


* Comprehensive mindfulness programmes with a premium membership to Calm
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On\-demand digital course library for professional development

... and other local benefits!


*At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*

\#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-JT1


Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

title: Python Developer Dehradun
description:
**Job Title: Trainee Software Engineer – FinLens / Bank Statement Analysis**  
**Location: Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India**  
**Experience Required: Freshers / Early Career**

Job Description

We are looking for a **Trainee Software Engineer** to join our team in Dehradun.

This role is not a generic full\-stack development role. The primary responsibility will be to work with **FinLens**, our bank statement analysis platform, and help deliver accurate bank statement analysis for lending and underwriting use cases.

The selected candidate will be trained to understand how bank statements are processed, analyzed, reviewed, and delivered. Over time, the person will also be expected to read existing Python/Django code, understand complex logic, debug issues, and make code changes wherever required to ensure successful delivery.

This role is suitable for someone who is curious, patient, analytical, and willing to work deeply on real\-world financial documents rather than only building screens or standard web applications.

Responsibilities

* Use FinLens to process and deliver bank statement analysis for client requirements.
* Review bank statement outputs and identify issues in parsing, categorization, calculations, or data interpretation.
* Understand different bank statement formats, transaction patterns, balances, cash flows, and analysis outputs.
* Investigate delivery issues by checking data, application behavior, logs, and code.
* Read and understand existing Python/Django code used in bank statement processing and analysis.
* Make small to medium code fixes under guidance to improve or correct analysis delivery.
* Work with senior engineers to troubleshoot complex cases where bank statements are messy, inconsistent, scanned, or unusually formatted.
* Support QA and operations teams in validating outputs before delivery.
* Document findings, fixes, and repeatable issues clearly.
* Gradually learn backend development, APIs, databases, testing, and deployment practices used in the product.
* Maintain discipline around accuracy, confidentiality, and client\-sensitive financial data.

Requirements

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or a related field.
* Freshers are welcome.
* Basic programming knowledge in Python.
* Basic understanding of web applications, APIs, databases, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Familiarity with Django or React will be helpful, but not mandatory.
* Familiarity with Git will be helpful.
* Strong comprehension skills. You should be comfortable reading existing code and understanding how it works.
* Strong analytical ability. Many problems will not have obvious answers and will require investigation.
* Patience to work with real\-world messy data, financial documents, and edge cases.
* Confidence to learn independently and solve problems step by step.
* Good attention to detail, especially when working with numbers and financial data.
* Good communication skills and willingness to ask clear questions when stuck.
* Interest in fintech, lending, AI\-assisted workflows, document processing, or data analysis will be a plus.

Good to Have

* Exposure to Python, Django, React, SQL, REST APIs, or Linux.
* Basic understanding of accounting, banking, lending, or financial statements.
* Experience with debugging, writing test cases, or reading logs.
* Exposure to AI tools, OpenAI, Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud systems will be a plus, but is not required.

What You Will Learn

* Real\-world fintech product development.
* Bank statement analysis and cash\-flow understanding.
* Python/Django backend development.
* Debugging production\-like issues.
* Working with complex document formats and financial data.
* Writing maintainable fixes in an existing codebase.
* How software is delivered in a live client environment.
* Practical use of AI, automation, and workflow systems in lending.

Benefits

* Learning\-oriented role with mentoring from experienced engineers.
* Opportunity to work on a real fintech product used for lending and underwriting.
* Exposure to Python, Django, document processing, AI workflows, and financial analytics.
* Collaborative and practical work environment.
* Opportunity to grow into a full software engineering role over time.
* Performance\-based growth opportunities.

Closing Note

We are not looking for someone who already knows everything. We are looking for someone who can learn deeply, think clearly, work carefully with data, and gradually become capable of handling complex bank statement analysis delivery and related code fixes.

Please submit your updated resume along with a brief note explaining why you are interested in this role.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹8,000\.00 \- ₹12,000\.00 per month

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Dehradun, Uttarakhand: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Python: 2 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

About the Role:  
We're looking for a builder, not a marketer. The ideal candidate loves writing Python scripts, automating repetitive workflows, and exploring what's possible with AI APIs. This role involves architecting and running a content automation pipeline that publishes SEO\-optimized blogs at scale on WordPress.

* Design and build end\-to\-end automation workflows using AI (Claude, GPT, Gemini) and publish directly to WordPress
* Develop Python scripts and WordPress REST API integrations for post creation, tagging, featured images, and internal linking

description:
**Experience:** 0 – 2 Years of Experience  
**Location:** Anna Nagar, Chennai  
**Department:** Editing and Post production

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a forward\-thinking **AI Multimedia Specialist** to redefine how we showcase properties. This isn't just a standard editing role you will blend traditional motion graphics and professional colour grading with cutting\-edge **Generative AI** workflows. Your mission is to turn static property photos and raw site footage into cinematic, "scroll\-stopping" video experiences that drive lead generation and brand prestige.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Motion Graphics \& Visual Effects (VFX)**

* **Animation:** Design and animate title, typography, lower thirds, and map call\-outs.

**2\. Professional Colour Grading**

* **Consistency:** Use **DaVinci Resolve** or **Premiere Pro** to match colours across multiple cameras, 3d rendering and lighting conditions

**3\. AI Generative Video \& Prompt Engineering**

* **AI Video Synthesis:** Utilize tools like **Runway Gen\-4**, **Luma Dream Machine, Kling**, or **Google Veo 3** to animate static listing photos into cinematic b\-roll.
* **Prompt Engineering:** Master "Text\-to\-Video" and "Image\-to\-Video" prompting to generate lifestyle elements (e.g., adding realistic fire to a cold fireplace, or moving clouds over a property).
* **Workflow Automation:** Use AI\-assisted tools in workflow to complete the project on time.

**Technical Requirements**

* **Software:** Basic level proficiency in **Adobe Creative Suite** (After Effects, Premiere, Photoshop) and **DaVinci Resolve**.

description:
**Position \- Center Coordinator**

**Available Locations: Chandigarh** 

**Local Language Punjabi is Must**

**Major Responsibilities:**

* Offer Care/ Support to Kids/ Families staying at the Centre(s). This is the primary mission of Organisation.
* Ensure that all the SOPs pertaining to their center/ area are being followed.
* Emphasis will be on strictly following COVID\-19 precautions including proper wearing of Masks, Gloves, using Sanitizers, Hand Wash, maintaining Social Distancing, quarantine/ isolation (when needed), etc.
* Should greet/ offer water/ be courteous to all the Visitors/ Guests/ Donors who visit their center.
* Should wish and thank all the Visitors/ Guests/ Donors who visit their center.
* Take photos of the Visitors/ Guests/ Donors with the families/kids and upload/ send in the right groups.
* Maintain the Visitor register and send snapshots regularly.
* Shall assist as required in Volunteer programs and support Volunteers coming to their centers.
* Take care of their personal grooming – wear clean, neat clothes and be presentable when outside their residential units.
* Take special care that Hygiene practices at the center are followed at all times.
* Should ensure that there is no lapse in this responsibility.
* Should monitor that no Non\-Veg food is prepared/served at the center for the kids/ families and oneself. Also, no Alcohol/ Gutkha, intoxicant substances are allowed as these are strictly prohibited in the premises. The Centre Coordinators themselves should set an example for this so that others can follow the same. (Only boiled eggs for kids, based on the advice of treating doctors will be permitted)
* Centre (esp. washrooms) have to be kept clean and well maintained at all the time.
* Plan the schedule and supervise the House keeping staff who visit the centers for daily cleanliness. CC shall guide them and take responsibility, as required.
* Shall maintain, report and follow\-up for regular payments of Utility Bills/ Petty cash associated with the Centre they are in\-charge of.
* Shall maintain a record of the Monthly Height/ Weight of the kids at their center.
* Shall offer full support of giving information/ pictures/ details for case studies.
* Update the CM on the requirements of Ration/ Vegetables/ Fruits/ other items and handle inventory when received.
* Shall maintain the records, reports and handle distribution of grocery/ toiletries to all the families at the center.
* Shall maintain daily updated records of all the Empty/ Occupied Units at their center and report regularly as needed.
* Shall immediately report incidents/ issues by mail/ Wapp and/or telephone, of all significant occurrences at or outside their center and which are related to the families. Guidance on what all and how they have to be reported, will be offered by the reporting officers.
* Shall take pictures of Meal Mate programs and events conducted at their center.
* Shall be responsible for giving Toilet/ Hand wash/ Hygiene training to all the families at their center.
* Maintain a ready updated list of all emergency contacts like Police/ Fire brigade/ Doctor/ Ambulance/ Plumber/ Carpenter/ etc. That is displayed and easily available to all.
* Shall assist in safe upkeep, handling, and servicing of all equipment, products, water purifier, fridge, washing machine, TV, CCTV, firefighting equipment, etc.existing at the center.
* Assist in planning, organizing, follow\-up, etc. of all Organisations events/ programs/ activities
* Shall update and coordinate Hospital trips of the families. Facilitate their transport to hospitals in emergency situations, as per the policy.
* Shall assist in E\-Tours which shall be conducted regularly as per the guidance offered by reporting officers.
* Shall maintain a Temperature/ SpO2 Register for all the families, kids and themselves during the COVID\-19 situation.
* Shall supervise any activity taking place at the center including Pest control, internet, gas supply, other Services, visits of MCGM Officials, etc.
* Shall ensure confidentiality of all Organisations data, kids/ family information, pictures, financial information, official communication, etc. as mandated by Organisations policy.
* Handle any other work /task as assigned by the CM/ reporting officers/ management, from time to time.

**Reporting, Documentation, etc.**

* Prepare and maintain Visitors’ Log.
* Maintaining the Data for temperature, SpO2, etc. carried out daily.
* Maintain the Monthly Weight/ Height Data for all the kids present at their center.
* Manage inventory of groceries, toiletries, etc. at the center
* Duty Hours, Rest pauses and Meal breaks

**The Daily schedule of the Centre coordinators including Meal Breaks is as given below,**

From 6:30 am to 8:00 am on duty

From 8:00 am to 10:00 am off time

From 10:00 am to 14:00 pm on duty

From 14:00 pm to 16:00 pm off time (Lunch \+ Rest)

From 16:00 pm to 19:00 pm on duty (Visitors)

The above mentioned timings is subject to the situation at that particular center. It can

change as per the circumstances and the nature/ priority of work at hand.

**Weekly Off**

The Weekly off for Centre Coordinator will be a week day (not weekend) and is fixed.

They are required to follow the same schedule. Weekly Off means that they can take

the day off and can step outside the Centre but have to return back to the centre before

night fall. In their absence, a temporary arrangement will be made in regards to taking

the responsibility of that centre. In case of work Emergencies / Training / Official

meetings, etc. falling on their weekly off day, the same can be adjusted after getting

prior approval from the Centre Manager in consultation with the HR Department. Centre

Coordinators are required to apply through the Employee Leave application form to

adjust and avail of their weekly off and compensatory offs, as per laid out procedure.

title: PROCESS COORDINATOR
description:
**JOB SUMMARY** 

The Process Coordinator is a critical role within the Newage operating structure. This person is responsible for monitoring, tracking, and reporting on the day\-to\-day movement of company processes — ensuring that every system, tracker, and workflow assigned to them is running as it should.

Every business runs on processes. At Newage, these processes have to move every day — and someone has to make sure they do. The Process Coordinator is that person. They do not execute the work themselves. Instead, they watch the work, check the trackers, identify where things are on track and where they are not, and report clearly and on time — every single day.

A Process Coordinator may be assigned to one or more processes depending on the needs of the business. Their value lies in making sure nothing drifts, nothing falls silent, and no problem is missed before it causes damage. This is a role built on discipline, consistency, and attention to detail.

**Why This Role Matters**

1\. Processes only work when someone is actively watching them — every day.

2\. Problems are easiest to fix when caught early — not after the damage is done.

3\. Daily monitoring gives management a clear, real\-time picture of how the business is running.

4\. The Process Coordinator is the person who makes sure nothing important goes unnoticed.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 

1\. Monitor all assigned process trackers on a daily basis and confirm that each one is active, updated, and moving as expected.

2\. Complete and submit a clear daily monitoring report covering the status of every assigned process — what is on track, what is delayed, and what needs attention.

3\. Identify any process that has stopped, stalled, or is not being updated, and flag it immediately to the relevant team lead or manager.

4\. Track the movement of tasks across assigned workflows from start to completion, ensuring no task is left unresolved or unaccounted for without a clear reason.

5\. Coordinate with process owners and team members to follow up on outstanding items and confirm that pending actions have been completed.

6\. Maintain accurate records of daily monitoring activity so that management has a clear, reliable view of operational health at all times.

7\. Support the preparation of weekly and monthly process health summaries, highlighting recurring issues, patterns, or areas that need improvement.

8\. Ensure all trackers and reporting tools assigned to you are kept clean, current, and consistent — no outdated data, no missing entries.

9\. Escalate any issues that cannot be resolved at coordination level to the appropriate manager promptly and clearly.

10\. Participate in regular operations reviews and provide accurate, factual input on the status of the processes you are monitoring.

11\. Suggest improvements to tracking tools or reporting formats when a better or simpler method is identified.

12\. Adapt to new processes as the business grows — take on additional trackers or workflows as assigned and maintain the same standard of daily monitoring.

**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE** 

1\. Graduate in any discipline

2\. Diploma holders with relevant experience will be considered

3\. Business administration or operations background is a plus — not a requirement Experience

1\. Freshers are welcome to apply

2\. Experience in coordination, operations, or admin is an advantage

3\. Prior use of trackers, checklists, or reporting tools is preferred

4\. Ability to work in a structured, process\-driven environment is essential

**SKILLS \& ABILITIES** 

1\. Clear written and verbal communication — able to report information accurately without confusion.

2\. Strong attention to detail — nothing is too small to check, and no entry is left unverified.

3\. Good time management — daily tasks are completed on schedule, every day.

4\. Ability to handle multiple trackers and processes simultaneously without losing track of any.

5\. Problem\-spotting ability — can identify when something is off, even before it becomes a bigger issue.

6\. Professional and consistent attitude — reliable, calm, and disciplined in daily output.

7\. Basic computer skills — comfortable working with spreadsheets, trackers, and digital reporting tools.

8\. Positive approach to feedback and learning — able to take direction and improve quickly.

**TOOLS \& TECHNOLOGY** 

The following tools are used regularly in this role:

**Tool / Platform Purpose**

Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets \- Daily tracker monitoring and data entry

Google Docs / Microsoft Word \- Writing and submitting daily monitoring reports

Company CRM / Internal Trackers \- Monitoring assigned processes and workflows

WhatsApp / Email \- Coordinating with team members and escalating issues

Google Drive / Shared Folders \- Storing and accessing reports and tracking files

**BENEFITS** 

1\. A structured role with clear daily responsibilities and defined growth pathways.

2\. Access to the Newage Learning Academy — continuous training and skill development.

3\. A supportive team environment where your work is visible and valued.

4\. Opportunity to grow into senior coordination or operations roles as the business expands.

5\. Exposure to a wide range of business processes, building strong operational knowledge over time.

6\. A stable, professional workplace that invests in its people.

**IDEAL CANDIDATE** 

The right person for this role brings discipline, honesty, and full ownership to their work — every single day. Here is who will thrive in this position:

You Are the Right Fit If You:

1\. Take your daily responsibilities seriously — not occasionally, but every single day without fail.

2\. Find satisfaction in keeping things in order and notice quickly when something is off.

3\. Communicate clearly and honestly — you do not hide problems or delay reporting them.

4\. Are disciplined and consistent — you bring the same standard to your work on a quiet day as on a busy one.

5\. Are comfortable working with data, trackers, and reporting tools and take pride in keeping them clean.

6\. Understand that your job is to watch, check, and report — and you do it with full ownership.

7\. Are eager to grow, take feedback well, and see this role as the foundation of a career in operations.

About the Company

Eythor Private Limited is a clean\-tech robotics startup developing AI\-powered, waterless solar panel cleaning and monitoring robots for rooftop and utility\-scale solar installations. We are working on robotics, embedded systems, IoT, automation, and renewable energy solutions.

Role Summary

We are looking for an Electronics Engineer who can support PCB design, embedded systems development, sensor integration, motor control, power electronics, and prototype testing for our solar panel cleaning robots. The candidate should be hands\-on, problem\-solving oriented, and interested in working on real hardware products.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and test electronic circuits for robotic systems.
* Work on PCB design, schematic creation, Gerber files, and component selection.
* Program microcontrollers such as ESP32, STM32, Arduino, or similar platforms.
* Integrate sensors such as IR sensors, proximity sensors, current sensors, temperature sensors, limit switches, and LDR sensors.
* Develop and test motor driver circuits for DC/BLDC motors.
* Work on power supply, battery, charging, and protection circuits.
* Support IoT communication using Wi\-Fi, Bluetooth, LoRa, or GSM modules.
* Troubleshoot electronics, wiring, PCB faults, and prototype issues.
* Coordinate with mechanical and software teams for complete robot integration.
* Prepare documentation, wiring diagrams, BOM, test reports, and assembly notes.

Required Qualifications

* Diploma / B.Tech / M.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, ECE, EEE, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, or related field.
* Basic knowledge of electronics circuits, PCB design, embedded systems, and sensors.
* Freshers with strong practical project experience can apply.

Technical Skills

* PCB design: KiCad, EasyEDA, Altium, Eagle, or similar.
* Microcontrollers: ESP32, STM32, Arduino, AVR, or similar.
* Programming: Embedded C / Arduino IDE / STM32CubeIDE.
* Motor drivers, relays, MOSFETs, voltage regulators, SMPS, and protection circuits.
* Soldering, multimeter, oscilloscope, power supply, and debugging tools.

Preferred Experience

* Robotics, automation, IoT, solar, EV, battery systems, or embedded product development.
* Experience in prototype building, testing, and field troubleshooting.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can send their resume, project portfolio, and previous PCB/embedded work samples to: **Recruitment.eythor@gmail.com**

Romford Holidays is a UK\-registered outbound tour operator (Romford International Ltd., London) expanding into the Indian market. We design and deliver group and customised tour packages across the UK, Europe, and Africa for Indian travellers, alongside visa consultation services. We are building a strong presence in the Indian outbound travel space and are looking for an experienced Operations Manager to drive our day\-to\-day operations and growth.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Operations Manager to lead our tour operations end\-to\-end. You will be responsible for sourcing and managing DMC partnerships, supervising the operations and sales team, and identifying new products, destinations, and partnerships to expand our offerings. This is a hands\-on leadership role suited to someone who enjoys building processes, negotiating with suppliers, and growing a travel business.

**Key Responsibilities**

DMC \& Supplier Management

* Identify, evaluate, and onboard Destination Management Companies (DMCs) across Europe, UK, Africa, and other key destinations
* Negotiate rates, contracts, and inclusions with DMCs, hotels, and ground operators
* Build and maintain strong long\-term supplier relationships to secure competitive pricing and priority service
* Ensure quality control of all DMC\-handled services (transfers, accommodation, sightseeing, guides)

Team \& Staff Management

* Supervise and mentor the operations, sales, and visa consultation team
* Allocate workloads, set targets, and review team performance
* Train new staff on internal processes, supplier systems, and product knowledge
* Handle escalations from staff and clients professionally

Product Development \& Business Growth

* Identify new B2B partnerships, agent networks, and distribution channels
* Stay updated on travel trends, visa policy changes, and competitor offerings in the Indian outbound market
* Work with management on pricing strategy, brochure development, and marketing inputs

Day\-to\-Day Operations

* Coordinate with visa, ticketing, and accounts teams for smooth file handling

title: HR Intern
description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI\-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world\-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Kormangala, Bangalore
   

  

**Working Days:** 
 6 Days a Week
   

  

**Experience:** 
 Fresher (0–1 year)
   

  

**Duration:** 
 3 months
   

  

**About the Role:**
 We are looking for a proactive and energetic HR Intern to support our day\-to\-day recruitment activities. This role is perfect for someone who wants to kick\-start their career in HR, enjoys interacting with people, and thrives in a fast\-paced startup environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Support end\-to\-end hiring for fresher and entry\-level roles
* Source, screen, and call candidates for various positions
* Schedule and coordinate interviews with hiring panels
* Maintain candidate trackers and ensure timely follow\-ups
* Assist in releasing offer letters and completing onboarding documentation
* Ensure strong communication and coordination between candidates and internal stakeholders
* Contribute to improving hiring processes and candidate experience


**Requirements:**
* Good written and verbal communication skills
* Strong organizational and follow\-up abilities
* Proactive attitude and willingness to learn
* Comfortable working in a dynamic startup environment
* Ability to manage multiple tasks at once
* Available to work 6 days a week


**Additional information:** 
  

  

* Free Lunch \+ Snacks Daily
* Cool workspace and fun team environment
+ Exclusive project goodies


**Our Values**
* Empathy, Trust \& Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* Bias for Action We practice high\-velocity decision\-making, clear\-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* Always Be Learning We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.


**About Instawork**
 Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI\-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!
   

  

 Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest\-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.
   

  

 Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in\-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face\-to\-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.
   

  

 Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www.instawork.com/about.
   

  

 Personnel Privacy Policy

title: Data Analyst -Treasury ( CA Freshers)
description:
Job Title: Data Analyst (Treasury Mid office)
 



 Department: Treasury – Debt \& Lending Alliances
 



 Location: Propelld Corporate Office, HSR Bangalore
 



 Experience: Freshers
 



 Job Type: Full\-Time
 



  





**About Propelld:** 




 Propelld is a leading fintech NBFC focused on providing innovative financial solutions in the education sector. We are data\-driven, using cutting\-edge analytics to offer personalized loan products and services to our clients.
 



  





**Job Summary:** 




 We are seeking a skilled personnel for Treasury mid office / Data Analyst with 2\-3 years of experience, strong proficiency in Excel, and a solid understanding of financial numbers and treasury operations. The ideal candidate will gather, analyze, and present data\-driven insights to help optimize product offerings, streamline operations, and enhance the customer experience.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 Perform data collection, cleaning, and analysis of large datasets from multiple sources, including loan performance, customer data, financial transactions, and treasury operations.
 



 Utilize Excel for advanced data analysis, including pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, macros, and complex formulas to generate insights.
 



 Build and maintain automated reports and interactive dashboards to track key financial metrics using Excel, Tableau.
 



 Support decision\-making processes by providing actionable insights and trends derived from data, particularly focusing on financial and treasury\-related information.
 



 Collaborate with product, marketing, and operations teams to improve business performance through data\-backed recommendations.
 



 Conduct A/B testing and statistical analysis to evaluate the impact of business experiments and initiatives.
 



 Use SQL for querying databases to extract and manipulate data efficiently.
 



 Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and quality of data through validation and best practices, with a specific focus on treasury and financial data.
 



 Present findings to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including senior management.
 



  





**Skills \& Qualifications:** 




 Preferred is Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field.
 



 Strong expertise in Excel for data analysis and reporting, including advanced functions like pivot tables, macros, and formula\-based analysis, especially with financial and treasury data.
 



 Experience with SQL for data extraction and manipulation.
 



 Familiarity with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI.
 



 Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex datasets and provide actionable insights, particularly in financial contexts.
 



 Experience with financial numbers and treasury operations is a primary requirement.
 



 Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
 



 Excellent communication skills for presenting data\-driven insights to cross\-functional teams.
 



  





**What We Offer:** 




 A fast\-paced work environment in a growing fintech company.
 



 Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits.
 



 Learning and growth opportunities within a collaborative, inclusive team culture.

title: Campus Graduate 2025-2026-8
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.
   

  

 Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple \- to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**About You And This Role**
 As a Campus Graduate in the Supply Chain Rotational Program, you will embark on a two\-year journey designed to build a strong foundation in supply chain management, logistics, and process improvement. This program offers a unique opportunity to gain hands\-on experience across multiple functions, including business supply chain operations, logistics execution, and strategic improvement initiatives.
   

  

 You will be part of a dynamic team that operates at the intersection of innovation and operational excellence. Through rotations, you will learn how to balance customer demand with production capabilities, optimize inventory, and ensure timely delivery of materials—all while contributing to cost efficiency and sustainability goals.
   

  

 This role is ideal for individuals who are curious, analytical, and eager to learn. You will apply conceptual knowledge of supply chain theories and business practices to solve real\-world challenges. Collaboration is key—you will work cross\-functionally with manufacturing, procurement, and logistics teams to deliver value to customers and stakeholders.
   

  

 Your contributions will directly impact on operational performance and customer satisfaction. While you will work independently on assigned tasks, you will also have access to mentorship and structured learning opportunities to accelerate your professional growth. By the end of the program, you will have developed a holistic understanding of supply chain management and be prepared for a career in a global organization that values innovation, sustainability, and continuous improvement.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Production Planning: Determine what, when, and where to produce for one or multiple sites to meet customer demand efficiently.
* Material Availability: Ensure timely and cost\-effective availability of materials in desired quantities for smooth operations and customer delivery.
* Demand\-Supply Balancing: Collaborate cross\-functionally to align forecasted demand with production utilization, manage inventory levels, and identify improvement opportunities.
* Logistics Expertise: Provide technical knowledge and support for carrier management, warehouse operations, international trade compliance, and transport mode optimization.
* Process Improvement: Identify, assess, and support tactical or strategic projects aimed at reducing costs, improving quality, and enhancing customer service within supply chain or logistics functions.


**Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in supply chain management, Engineering, Business, Mathematics, or related disciplines.
* Strong analytical and logical thinking skills; ability to apply concepts to practical scenarios.


**Your Skills**
* Data Analysis: Ability to interpret and leverage data for decision\-making, forecasting, and performance optimization within supply chain operations.
* Quality Assurance (QA): Ensuring compliance with standards and maintaining accuracy in processes to deliver consistent, high\-quality outcomes.
* Proactive Problem Solving: Anticipating challenges and implementing effective solutions to maintain operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.
* Customer Service \& Client Counseling: Building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, understanding their needs, and providing tailored solutions.
* Process Improvements \& Innovation: Identifying opportunities for efficiency, introducing innovative practices, and supporting continual improvement initiatives.
* Supply Chain Planning (SCP): Applying planning principles to balance demand and supply, optimize inventory, and ensure timely delivery of products.


**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**
 We invest in you.
   

  

 Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
   

  

 Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:
   

  

* Equitable and market\-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.
* Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well\-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.
* Competitive retirement program that may include company\-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial\-goals.
+ Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).

* Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only).
+ Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.

* Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations.
* Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building.
* Workplace culture empowering role\-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs.
* Competitive yearly vacation allowance.
* Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non\-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents).
* Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured.
* Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation.
* Wellbeing Portal for all Dow employees, our one\-stop shop to promote wellbeing, empowering employees to take ownership of their entire wellbeing journey.
* On\-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location).
* Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more.
* Additionally, some of our locations might offer:
+ Transportation allowance (availability varies depending on location)
+ Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location)
+ Carbon\-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location)


 Join our team, we can make a difference together.
   

  

**About Dow Chemical International Pvt Ltd**
 Dow Chemical International Private Limited (Dow India) aims to be the most innovative, sustainable, inclusive customer\-centric materials science company. The company is committed to delivering the right solutions to its customers’ challenges. With broadest technology sets spanning performance materials, industrial intermediates, and plastics Dow India delivers differentiated science\-based products and solutions in high\-growth segments, such as packaging, infrastructure, automobile, and consumer care.
   

  

 A Great Place to Work® Certified company with approximately over 1000 employees, its operations comprise of manufacturing sites, innovation center, established centers of excellence, and commercial office. As a responsible corporate, the company supports its Corporate Social Responsibility (program) with technology expertise and employee volunteerism. Dow India works with non\-profit partners towards the empowerment of differently abled, women, and children in communities where it operates. The company aims to redefine the societal blueprint, by supporting holistic sustainability and circular economy initiatives.
   

  

 As part of our dedication to inclusion, Dow is committed to equal opportunities in employment. We encourage every employee to bring their whole self to work each day to not only deliver more value, but also have a more fulfilling career. Further information regarding Dow's equal opportunities is available on www.dow.com.

title: PROJECT MANAGER L2
description:
Job description:
   

  

 Job Description
 
  

**Role** 




 The purpose of the role is to manage delivery of a project driving operations and delivery governance, ensuring right talent supply chain to optimize customer satisfaction and cost of delivery
   

  
 


 ͏ ͏
 
**Do** 




 \- Delivery Management
   

 \- Ensure seamless delivery of the projects 
   

 \- Deploy optimum project delivery structure post transition/ migration phase by evaluating the budget, costs, risks and staffing requirement 
   

 \- Create quarterly project charter with well\-defined weekly project trajectory as per the project specifications \& requirements and ensure 100% adherence in terms of schedule, quality, efforts and costs 
 



  

 \- Ensure 100% compliance to Project SLAs, information security protocols and etc (all customers contractual obligations)
   

 \- Monitor and take appropriate actions on internal and external audit findings to ensure no major non\-compliance/ deviation from the SLA
   

 \- Liaise between customer and internal technical delivery team to drive project health by adhering to organizational norms of project metrics
   

 \- Drive various project related audits like quality, customer, ISO etc and ensure zero non\-compliance
   

 \- Conduct periodic cadence with the quality team to take proactive measures to resolves issues/ possible escalations
   

 \- Conducts periodic cadence with Workforce Management Group (WMG) to ensure 100% fulfillment as per the program/ project requirement
   

 \- Regularly audit quality (QA) status of delivery and engage QA team to ensure adherence to Quality Assurance standards and processes
   

 \- Maintain project structure in Confluence \& SAP in line with prevailing business requirements and norms
   

 \- Ensure expected ramp down (ERD) compliance as committed in MSA
 



 \- Client Relationship Management
   

 \- Engage with client to deploy opportunities to deploy multiple solutions within/ across SLs to create a stronger value proposition for clients
   

 \- Conduct regular customer connects (meetings/ visits/ video\- conference) and participate in Management Review Meetings (MRM) with client management/engagement managers to understand customers current and future needs and seek feedback to improve delivery methodology/ timelines/ resource allocation
   

  
 


 ͏
 
 Identify and close early warnings on a project to avoid any customer escalations
   

 \- Plan and conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) along with DMs/ ADH with the client management/ leadership team to drive improvement actions and mine for a new portfolio/ opportunity within the account
   

 \- Design and monitor project performance dashboards/ reports with the clients periodically
 



 \- Delivery governance across the project
   

 \- Create weekly/ monthly/ quarterly MIS and reports to monitor and track overall project
   

 \- Conduct periodic reviews with the delivery team on operational, quality and fulfillment parameters and new idea generation \& its implementation on existing projects
 



 \- Identify and resolve potential risks or early warning signs on project delivery to drive for ZERO surprise escalations and eliminate any revenue leakage
   

 \- Escalate any deviations from the project charter to the delivery managers in terms of schedule, effort, cost, infrastructure from the project charter and minimize process exceptions and such deviations from the actual project plan
   

 \- Review and monitor revenue allocations/ realization to avoid OB revenue leakage
   

 \- Provide inputs to delivery leadership team on overall delivery performance parameters (project heath, utilization, realization etc) at project/ program level during reviews highlighting any critical project escalations and potential risks
 



 \- Operational Excellence
   

 \- Automation Focus
   

 \- Perform pareto analysis as per the no. of incidents received and accordingly identify automation opportunities and drive value adds across the project
   

 \- Deploy next generation hyper automation and crowdsourcing initiatives in coordination with Holmes RO team to enhance productivity, quality and speed of delivery
 



  

 \- Interact and engage with tools team to bring in new tools in the project to automate certain pointers/ elimination of any noise in the project
   

  
 


 ͏
 
 \- Innovation Focus
   

 \- Brainstorm with the team to identify improvement opportunities and initiatives to further improve quality, delivery speed and productivity parameters
   

 \- Drive value adds and BVMs; ensure management showcases them to customer in MRM \& QBR to drive growth
 



 \- Plan and conduct periodic idea campaigns to generate new solutions to the problems/ define better ways of working
 



 \- Drive and deploy Knowledge Management and sharing 
   

 \- Contribute in internal knowledge sharing initiatives at Wipro by driving internal training sessions, best practices, learnings, value adds and BVMs and deploys best practices in various projects within own account
   

 \- Deploy the Wipro's knowledge management portal across the account and monitor \& track trainings
 



 \- Capability Development and Talent Pipeline Creation
   

 \- Demand forecasting in line with business requirements 
   

 \- Anticipate attrition and ensure right talent supply chain to deliver the project
   

 \- Spearhead quarterly demand forecasting and resource planning aligned to project requirements
 



  

 \- Create and deploy a workplan to fulfil the required demand from all the talent channels including external (lateral, contractors etc) hiring in coordination with WMG/ CWMG and Talent Acquisition team
   

 \- Anticipate new skills/ upcoming technologies required to deliver the project and ensure the team is trained or right talent is inducted into the project as per the skill requirements
 



 \- Drive 100% compliance on trainings and upskilling requirements 
   

 \- Prioritize and identify essential and upcoming technical skills required across programs/ projects to facilitate and drive right supply chain
   

 \- Drive towards 100% mandatory training compliance for the target population within an account
 



 \- Plan and drive rotations for seed positions and ensure replacement plan to be arrived ahead of rotations
   

 \- Quarterly connect with critical talent to understand their career aspirations and create their learning maps along with project managers and HRBP
 



 \- Fresher engagement program
   

 \- Ensure a stable arrangement and assimilation of rookie within accounts in coordination with competency group team (classroom trainings/ e\-learning, certifications, on the job training etc)
 



 \- Team Management
   

 \- Resourcing
   

 \- Forecast talent requirements as per the current and future business needs
   

 \- Hire adequate and right resources for the team
 



 \- Talent Management
   

 \- Ensure adequate onboarding and training for the team members to enhance capability \& effectiveness
   

 \- Build an internal talent pool and ensure their career progression within the organization
 



  

 \- Manage team attrition
   

 \- Drive diversity in leadership positions
   

 \- Performance Management
   

 \- Set goals for the team, conduct timely performance reviews and provide constructive feedback to own direct reports
   

 \- Ensure that the Performance Nxt is followed for the entire team
 



 \- Employee Satisfaction and Engagement
   

 \- Lead and drive engagement initiatives for the team
   

 \- Track team satisfaction scores and identify initiatives to build engagement within the team
 



 \- Facilitate rewards and recognition to acknowledge the high performers in the team
 







 Mandatory Skills: Telecom Network Content Security .
 



  
 



 Experience: \>10 YEARS
   

 .
 



  
 



 Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end\-to\-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

title: PROJECT MANAGER L1
description:
Job description:
   

  

 Job Description
 
  

**Role** 




 The purpose of the role is to manage delivery of a project driving operations and delivery governance, ensuring right talent supply chain to optimize customer satisfaction and cost of delivery
 


 ͏
 
**Do** 




 \- Delivery Management
   

 \- Ensure seamless delivery of the projects 
   

 \- Deploy optimum project delivery structure post transition/ migration phase by evaluating the budget, costs, risks and staffing requirement 
   

 \- Create quarterly project charter with well\-defined weekly project trajectory as per the project specifications \& requirements and ensure 100% adherence in terms of schedule, quality, efforts and costs 
 



  

 \- Ensure 100% compliance to Project SLAs, information security protocols and etc (all customers contractual obligations)
   

 \- Monitor and take appropriate actions on internal and external audit findings to ensure no major non\-compliance/ deviation from the SLA
   

 \- Liaise between customer and internal technical delivery team to drive project health by adhering to organizational norms of project metrics
   

 \- Drive various project related audits like quality, customer, ISO etc and ensure zero non\-compliance
   

 \- Conduct periodic cadence with the quality team to take proactive measures to resolves issues/ possible escalations
   

 \- Conducts periodic cadence with Workforce Management Group (WMG) to ensure 100% fulfillment as per the program/ project requirement
   

 \- Regularly audit quality (QA) status of delivery and engage QA team to ensure adherence to Quality Assurance standards and processes
   

 \- Maintain project structure in Confluence \& SAP in line with prevailing business requirements and norms
   

 \- Ensure expected ramp down (ERD) compliance as committed in MSA
 



 \- Client Relationship Management
   

 \- Engage with client to deploy opportunities to deploy multiple solutions within/ across SLs to create a stronger value proposition for clients
   

 \- Conduct regular customer connects (meetings/ visits/ video\- conference) and participate in Management Review Meetings (MRM) with client management/engagement managers to understand customers current and future needs and seek feedback to improve delivery methodology/ timelines/ resource allocation
 



 \- Identify and close early warnings on a project to avoid any customer escalations
   

 \- Plan and conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) along with DMs/ ADH with the client management/ leadership team to drive improvement actions and mine for a new portfolio/ opportunity within the account
   

 \- Design and monitor project performance dashboards/ reports with the clients periodically
 



 \- Delivery governance across the project
   

 \- Create weekly/ monthly/ quarterly MIS and reports to monitor and track overall project
   

 \- Conduct periodic reviews with the delivery team on operational, quality and fulfillment parameters and new idea generation \& its implementation on existing projects
 



 \- Identify and resolve potential risks or early warning signs on project delivery to drive for ZERO surprise escalations and eliminate any revenue leakage
   

 \- Escalate any deviations from the project charter to the delivery managers in terms of schedule, effort, cost, infrastructure from the project charter and minimize process exceptions and such deviations from the actual project plan
   

 \- Review and monitor revenue allocations/ realization to avoid OB revenue leakage
   

 \- Provide inputs to delivery leadership team on overall delivery performance parameters (project heath, utilization, realization etc) at project/ program level during reviews highlighting any critical project escalations and potential risks
 


 ͏
 
 \- Operational Excellence
   

 \- Automation Focus
