**Location:** Office No. 1505, 15th Floor, The Orion Business Park, Shimpoli Junction, S.V. Road, Borivali West, Mumbai 400092 **Job Type:** Full\-Time \| In\-Person Only

**Compensation:** ₹25,000 per month

**Experience Required:** Minimum 3 years

**Read This Before Applying**

This is not a "post daily and reply to comments" role. You will be the only creative person on the team. No creative director above you. No team below you. No one to design for you, edit your videos, or tell you what to post. You will own TradeClover's entire visual identity and social media presence from top to bottom. If you need direction on what to create, this is not for you. If you can build a brand presence from scratch and make it grow, keep reading.

**What You Must Know (Non\-Negotiable)**

* **Design:** Figma — UI mockups, social creatives, pitch decks, brand assets. Not just templates, actual design sense.
* **Motion \& Animation:** 2D animations using After Effects, Jitter, or equivalent. Motion graphics for reels, explainer videos, product walkthroughs. Not just transitions.
* **Video Production:** Scripting, shooting (basic), and editing full\-length videos — not just 30\-second reels. YouTube\-style content, demo videos, testimonials.
* **Short\-Form Content:** Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts — but this is the floor, not the ceiling.
* **Strategy:** Content calendars, platform\-specific strategies, growth planning, knowing what content to make and why.
* **Copywriting:** Writing captions, hooks, video scripts, and ad copy that actually convert. You understand tone.
* **Analytics:** Reading what works and what doesn't across Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube. You make decisions from data, not feelings.
* **Platform Fluency:** Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube — you understand how each algorithm works and you tailor content accordingly.
* **Brand Building:** You can take a B2B startup with zero presence and build something people recognize and trust.

**What You Will Own**

Everything creative. Brand identity, social presence across all platforms, video content, motion graphics, creatives for campaigns, ad visuals, onboarding decks, and anything else the company needs visually. You decide the strategy. You execute it. You measure it. You improve it.

**Who Should NOT Apply**

* Anyone who only knows how to make reels and post them
* Anyone who needs a designer to hand them assets to edit
* Anyone who has never made a video longer than 60 seconds
* Anyone who cannot think in strategy and only works execution
* Anyone looking for remote or hybrid work

* Freshers or anyone with under 3 years of real, end\-to\-end creative experience

At Citi, we get to connect millions of people across hundreds of cities and countries every day. And we've been doing it for more than 200 years. We do this through our unparalleled global network. We provide a broad range of financial services and products to our clients – whether they be consumers, corporations, governments or institutions – to help them meet their biggest opportunities and face the world's toughest challenges.
   

  

 HR Partner \& Delivery sits at the center of Citi’s HR business solutions. This newly created team future proposition is to provide guidance and coaching to managers on all employee life\-cycle processes, solving day to day HR needs for employee by leveraging technology to provide simple and effective employee focused processes.
   

  

 We’re currently looking for a high caliber professional to join our team as HR Delivery Relationship Manager, Assistant Vice President \- Hybrid based in Mumbai, India.
   

  

 Being part of our team means that we’ll provide you with the resources to meet your unique needs, empower you to make healthy decision and manage your financial well\-being to help plan for your future. For instance:
   

  

* Citi provides programs and services for your physical and mental well\-being including access to telehealth options, health advocates, confidential counseling and more. Coverage varies by country.
* We believe all parents deserve time to adjust to parenthood and bond with the newest members of their families. That’s why in early 2020 we began rolling out our expanded Paid Parental Leave Policy to include Citi employees around the world.
* We empower our employees to manage their financial well\-being and help them plan for the future.
* Citi provides access to an array of learning and development resources to help broaden and deepen your skills and knowledge as your career progresses.
* We have a variety of programs that help employees balance their work and life, including generous paid time off packages.
* We offer our employees resources and tools to volunteer in the communities in which they live and work.


 This role will support the HRP\&D team to deliver process design and re\-engineering solutions, ensuring the employee and manager experience is foremost in the design thinking. Working in an agile environment partnering with project managers and specialist supporting process change.
   

  

 The HR Delivery Relationship Manager is an intermediate level position responsible for providing operations support services, including but not limited to; record/documentation maintenance, storage \& retrieval of records, account maintenance, imaging and the opening of accounts in coordination with the Operations \- Core Team. Additionally, the role serves as the liaison between operations staff, relationship managers, project managers, custodians and clients. The overall objective of this role is to provide day\-to\-day operations support in alignment with Citi operations support infrastructure and processes.
   

  

**In this role, you are expected to:**
* Perform in\-depth evaluation of basic operations and business processes, family procedures, and industry standards for business supported to identify and resolve complex problems
* Influence decisions through advice and counsel as well as facilitate services to others in area
* Serve as an analytical and/or procedural expert, representing a unit or team on cross function operational processes and project deliverables
* Liaises with multiple teams across the Operations department
* Coordinate and contribute to initiatives that support the goals of the Operations function and overall business
* Assume informal and formal leadership role within team as well as coach and train new recruits
* Has the ability to operate with a limited level of direct supervision.
* Can exercise independence of judgement and autonomy.
* Acts as SME to senior stakeholders and /or other team members.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.


**As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:**
* 5\-8 years of relevant experience
* Proficient in Microsoft Office
* Ability and experience working in a fast paced, high\-pressure environment
* Proven organization and time management skills
* Demonstrated problem\-solving and decision\-making skills
* Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication skills


**Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience


 This job description provides a high\-level review of the types of work performed. Other job\-related duties may be assigned as required.
   

  

 Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a family of more than 230,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.
   

  

 Take the next step in your career, apply for this role at Citi today
   

  

 https://jobs.citi.com/dei
   

  

 Other tasks include:
   

  

* Responsible for creating and sustaining effective partnership with HR and O\&T partners through collaboration on strategies and initiatives, propose automation and efficiency opportunities in the process based on the feedback of key partners (pillars/ CHROs etc.)
* Responsible for aligning the interaction model with all relevant stakeholders and HRSS pillars.
* Escalation Management
* \- Manage process delivery escalations and partners with Regional Operational Services and Global Processes Leads to coordinate root cause analysis and remediation plan for resolutions and work on required controls to be put in place. Ensure all stakeholders are kept regularly informed of progress to closure, providing visibility on resolution and including incident report status.
* Executive support/case management
* Maintain regular touchpoint with HR partners and relevant stakeholders
* \- Ensure effective delivery and execution of processes through partnering with HR to translate policies into operational processes, identifying key controls, driving improvement and measuring performance
* \- Play the role of an advisor/partner and build strategic relationship with Country, Regional, Product HR partners to identify sustainable actions, drive common practices and eliminate pain points.
* \- Conduct Monthly and/or Quarterly meeting with CHROs and O\&T Heads, Cluster CHROs, HRPS, COEs and HR partner, as applicable.
* \- Support the execution of initiatives that come as part of the VOP surveys.
* Perform HRSS Pillar Process Review, improvement, investigation and resolution
* \- Provides expert problem management support to difficult or complex issues and ensures root\-cause analysis is conducted with any learning applied for future benefit.
* Lead HRSS country/pillar huddles
* \- Liaise and collaborate with Regional Stakeholder Services relationship managers and representatives, Regional Office, CSC and local HR partners to execute business initiatives.
* Perform Projects and Initiatives implementation
* \- Steer global/ regional priorities and projects for country(ies) under scope in partnership with the operational services and global processes.
* \- Discuss strategic topics, progress of initiatives and action plans, results and metrics with stakeholders including Country Senior Management.

title: Factory HR
description:
**Company Description** 




 Sresta Natural Bioproducts Private Limited is India's pioneering brand in organic food, dedicated to providing pure, sustainable, and health\-focused products since 2004\. With a mission to support over 30,000 farmers across 1,20,000 acres in 15 states, Sresta fosters organic communities and ensures sustainable livelihoods. The company boasts a wide range of over 200 products, including staples, processed foods, fruit juices, and ready\-to\-cook meal options, catering to diverse consumer needs throughout the day. Sresta's products are available in more than 1,500 outlets across India and abroad, as well as in company\-owned stores.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 This is a full\-time, on\-site role for a Factory HR professional, based in Hyderabad. As a Factory HR, you will be responsible for managing and implementing HR policies, overseeing employee benefits, and ensuring compliance with organizational standards and labor laws. Daily responsibilities will also include personnel management, addressing employee concerns, supporting recruitment and onboarding efforts, and fostering a positive workplace environment that aligns with company goals.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Experience in Human Resources (HR) and Personnel Management
* Proficiency in HR Management, including overseeing recruitment, onboarding, and employee relations
* Knowledge of HR Policies and Employee Benefits
* Strong understanding of labor laws and regulatory compliance
* Excellent communication, problem\-solving, and interpersonal skills
* Ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams and build positive workplace culture
* Relevant experience within the manufacturing or food industry is a plus
* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or a related field

**Whats in it for you?**
 At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you. 
   

  
   

 As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market\- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day. 
   

  
   

 Our Tesco Rewards framework consists of pillars \- Fixed Pay, Incentives, and Benefits.  
   

  
   

 Total Rewards offered at Tesco is determined by four principles \- simple, fair, competitive, and sustainable. 
   

  
   

**Salary** 
 \- Your fixed pay is the guaranteed pay as per your contract of employment. 
   

  
   

**Performance Bonus** 
 \- Opportunity to earn additional compensation bonus based on performance, paid annually 
   

  
   

**Leave \& Time\-off** 
 \- Colleagues are entitled to 30 days of leave (18 days of Earned Leave, 12 days of Casual/Sick Leave) and 10 national and festival holidays, as per the company’s policy. 
   

  
   

**Making Retirement Tension\-FreeSalary** 
 \- In addition to Statutory retirement beneets, Tesco enables colleagues to participate in voluntary programmes like NPS and VPF. 
   

  
   

**Health is Wealth** 
 \- Tesco promotes programmes that support a culture of health and wellness including insurance for colleagues and their family. Our medical insurance provides coverage for dependents including parents or in\-laws. 
   

  
   

**Mental Wellbeing** 
 \- We offer mental health support through self\-help tools, community groups, ally networks, face\-to\-face counselling, and more for both colleagues and dependents.  
   

  
   

**Financial Wellbeing** 
 \- Through our financial literacy partner, we offer one\-to\-one financial coaching at discounted rates, as well as salary advances on earned wages upon request.  
   

  
   

**Save As You Earn (SAYE)** 
 \- Our SAYE programme allows colleagues to transition from being employees to Tesco shareholders through a structured 3\-year savings plan.  
   

  
   

**Physical Wellbeing** 
 \- Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle. 
   

**About Us**
 At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion are deeply embedded in our values—we treat people how they want to be treated. Our goal is for all colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work, and we are committed to helping them thrive. Across the Tesco group, we are building an inclusive workplace that actively celebrates the cultures, personalities, and preferences of our colleagues, who in turn contribute to the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. 
   

  
   

  At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities. We are dedicated to offering equal opportunities for all candidates and encourage applicants with disabilities to apply. Our recruitment process is fully accessible, and we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments during interviews. If you need any accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to ensure that everyone has the chance to succeed. 
   

  
   

  We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. Our hybrid model allows you to work flexibly—spend 60% of your week collaborating in person with colleagues at our office locations or local sites, and the rest of the time working remotely. We understand that everyone’s life journey is unique, whether you are starting your career, pursuing passions, or navigating life changes, and we are here to support you. Flexibility is a core part of our culture, and we encourage open conversations about how we can best accommodate your needs, so talk to us throughout your application process on the support required.

title: Quality Control - DET
description:
**Position Summary**
 The Diploma Trainee Engineer – Quality Control supports quality assurance activities by assisting in inspection, testing, and documentation of manufactured components. This role provides hands\-on training in quality control processes, measurement techniques, and compliance with applicable standards under the supervision of experienced quality engineers.
   

  

**Work You’ll Do**
* Assist in inspection and measurement of components using basic quality tools and instruments.
* Support incoming, in\-process, and final inspection activities as per quality plans.
* Help identify non\-conformities and report deviations to senior quality engineers.
* Assist in maintaining inspection records, reports, and quality documentation.
* Support implementation of quality procedures, work instructions, and SOPs.
* Follow safety, quality, and housekeeping standards on the shop floor.


**Team**
 This role will be part of the Quality Assurance and Control team within the manufacturing facility, working closely with production, engineering, and senior quality personnel to ensure products meet defined quality standards.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Diploma in Mechanical / Production / Industrial Engineering or related discipline.
* Fresher or up to 1 year of industrial training or quality\-related experience.
* Basic understanding of engineering drawings and measurement concepts.
* Familiarity with measuring instruments such as vernier calipers and micrometers.
* Willingness to learn quality processes and work in a manufacturing environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Exposure to quality control practices through internship or apprenticeship.
* Basic knowledge of quality standards such as ISO 9001\.
* Awareness of shop\-floor inspection and manufacturing processes.
* Good communication skills and attention to detail.


**Who We Are**
 Milacron is a global leader in the manufacture, distribution and service of highly engineered and customized systems within the $27 billion plastic technology and processing industry. We are the only global company with a full\-line product portfolio that includes hot runner systems, injection molding, extrusion equipment. We maintain strong market positions across these products, as well as leading positions in process control systems, mold bases and components, maintenance, repair and operating (“MRO”) supplies for plastic processing equipment. Our strategy is to deliver highly customized equipment, components and service to our customers throughout the lifecycle of their plastic processing technology systems.

title: Network Engineer
description:
**About Xerox Holdings Corporation**
 At Xerox,
 **we make work, work!** 
 For more than 100 years, Xerox has continually redefined the workplace experience. From the office to industrial environments, our differentiated business and technology offerings and financial services are essential workplace technology solutions that drive success for our clients and within our culture. Learn more at www.xerox.com and explore our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging.
   

  

 Job Title
   

  

 Network Engineer
   

  

 Job Description:
   

  

 Our technology is outstanding, but it’s the talented, diverse, and driven people behind our company who make it all happen. Our employees have the determination to go further, the adaptability to adjust to an ever\-changing global market, the heart to stay passionate and personally invested, and the mind to know when to step back and put it all in perspective.
   

  

 Lexmark (A Subsidiary of Xerox Corporation) is in search of a seasoned network operations engineer with a passion for operating, executing, and enhancing standard processes for maintaining an enterprise network. The selected candidate will collaborate with multiple teams to ensure the implementation of IT operations, security, and network policies. The role involves working with architecture and business teams to ensure the availability of the enterprise network. The engineer will also be responsible for monitoring tool efficiency, setting guidelines, and eliminating barriers to achieve desired outcomes. Additionally, they will liaise with other IT operation teams to resolve any network\-related issues. The ideal candidate must possess robust communication skills and the ability to manage competing priorities effectively.
   

  

 WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING:
   

  

 Remote Administration and troubleshooting of switches, routers, firewalls, and cloud networks.
   

  

 Configuration and management of multiple network security systems to include next gen firewalls, unified threat management services, and Secure Access Service Edge (SASE).
   

  

 Deployment of public cloud network services including virtual networks, load balancers, web application firewalls, and virtual gateways.
   

  

 Execution of standard network delivery processes such as VLAN creation, route advertisements, firewall policy configurations, DNS record changes, IPAM network creation, network performance reports, network infrastructure hardening, software/hardware licensing, and virtual network peering.
   

  

 Coordination of high\-impact infrastructure changes and outages during on and off\-hours.
   

  

 Collaboration with architecture teams providing design feedback, process improvement opportunities, and potential solution enhancements.
   

  

 Act as the escalation contact for the network helpdesk and incident managers.
   

  

 Communicate regularly with management and architecture teams on operational metrics.
   

  

 Light travel will be required to meet with international teams.
   

  

 Hands on support for the deployment of new infrastructure and maintenance of existing infrastructure at the company headquarters location.
   

  

 Be an advocate and change leader for network\-security initiatives and operational processes with a goal of improving the overall culture.
   

  

**Must\-have Qualifications, Skills, Experience**
 Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering or related field with 3\-5 years of networking and security experience.
   

  

 Advanced knowledge of LAN, WAN, VLAN, Public Cloud, Wireless, and VoIP networking technologies.
   

  

 Advance knowledge of routing protocols to include Border Gateway Protocol (BGP), Open Shortest Path First (OSPF), and Enhanced Interior Gateway Routing Protocol (EIGRP).
   

  

 Advanced knowledge of network security concepts, including web filters, NIDPS, DLP, SSL\-DPI, firewalls, etc.
   

  

 Advanced knowledge of network services, including DNS, DHCP, IPAM, SNMP, IPSec, NetFlow.
   

  

 Knowledge of Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) and Network Access Control (NAC) technologies.
   

  

 Knowledge of scripting, automation, and DevOps functions including Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) and Configuration\-as\-Code (CaC).
   

  

 Experience working with Fortinet, Cisco, InfoBlox, Microsoft Azure, and Amazon Web Services (AWS) technologies.
   

  

 Experience with client facing Network Operations Center (NOC) support.
   

  

 Advanced troubleshooting and diagnostic skills.
   

  

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
   

  

 Experience with ITSM, ITIL, NIST, CIS, and ISO 27001 frameworks.
   

  

 Proven ability to lead and manage multiple priorities with proven organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks with changing priorities.
   

  

 Experience with working with onshore and offshore global teams.
   

  

 Strong ability in multiple technologies, analytical techniques, and leadership skills.
   

  

 In\-depth knowledge of Operational Processes (Event, Incident, Change, Problem).
   

  

 Preferred Certifications:
   

  

 Microsoft Azure Certifications (AZ\-900, AZ\-700, AZ\-500, AZ\-204\)
   

  

 CompTIA \+ Certifications (Network\+, Security\+)
   

  

 Cisco Certifications (CCNA, CCNP)
   

  

**Educational Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
   

  

**Years Of Experience In This Field**
 3 to 7 years of experience as a Network Engineer in a global company.

title: Engineer II - Network Engineering
description:
When you join Verizon
   

  

 You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing…**
 As a Network Engineer, your primary focus is to evaluate how our network is managed and identify manual tasks that should be converted into automated workflows. You will study existing operational habits and system data to find inefficiencies.
   

  

* Analyze Operational Workflows: Review current network management processes and alarm data to identify repetitive manual interventions.
* Identify Automation Opportunities: Pinpoint specific areas where scripts or automated logic can replace manual troubleshooting or configuration steps.
* Evaluate Business Impact: Conduct deep\-dive investigations into various systems to determine which process improvements will provide the most significant time and cost savings.
* Align with Global Strategy: Coordinate with the US\-based engineering team to ensure your automation proposals solve current operational bottlenecks.


**What We’re Looking For…**
 You are a logical thinker who naturally looks for ways to make technical work more efficient. You enjoy deconstructing a complex manual process and figuring out the step\-by\-step logic required to automate it.
   

  

**You’ll Need To Have**
* Bachelor’s degree with one or more years of professional work experience.
* Significant experience in Networking and knowledge of Network Automation.
* Functional knowledge of scripting and database management to develop integrated technical solutions.
* Analytical experience: The ability to look at complex technical datasets and identify patterns that suggest a need for a new automation.
* The ability to quickly learn and navigate internal systems to gather data for process reviews.
* Willingness to work a schedule that includes overlap with US Day shift.


**Even Better If You Have**
* A degree in Computer Science or a related field.
* Experience interpreting existing automation scripts to improve or expand their functionality.

 Optiver’s bespoke infrastructure offers a diverse network engineering experience. Advance your career in a unique environment, where you'll be supported to find the simplest solutions to some of the most complex problems in the financial markets.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Optiver is a global market maker founded in Amsterdam, with offices in London, Chicago, Austin, New York, Sydney, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Singapore, Taipei and Mumbai. Established in 1986, today we are a leading liquidity provider, with close to 2,000 employees in offices around the world, united in our commitment to improve the market through competitive pricing, execution and risk management. By providing liquidity on multiple exchanges across the world in various financial instruments we participate in the safeguarding of healthy and efficient markets. We provide liquidity to financial markets using our own capital, at our own risk, trading a wide range of products: listed derivatives, cash equities, ETFs, bonds and foreign currencies.
   

  

 In Asia Pacific, Optiver was one of the first global market makers to establish a presence in the region, with the incorporation our Sydney office in 1996\. Since then, we have expanded our footprint by establishing offices in Taipei (2005\), Hong Kong (2007\), Shanghai (2012\) and Singapore (2021\). The business in Mumbai is newly established and deemed to be an integral part of the APAC strategy, with an anticipation of significant growth over the coming years.

 As a Network Engineer, you will:
   

  

  

* Be responsible for the infrastructure underpinning our trading and non\-trading activity, including office networks and a complex WAN environment. Our infrastructure needs to be reliable, fast and well supported and our Network Engineers are constantly making optimisations in reliability, capacity, scalability and latency.
* Build intimate knowledge of exchange environments, as well as Optiver’s trading systems, influencing low\- and high\-level designs.
* Deploy, monitor and configure network infrastructure, as well as support end\-to\-end infrastructure deployments in Asia Pacific data centers.

This role ensures stable, secure, and scalable network services for Ensono and its customers by developing, implementing, and maintaining network, security/threat, and voice solutions.
   

  

 The Network Engineer works independently on complex assignments, collaborates with senior engineers and cross‑functional teams, and provides technical guidance and mentorship to less experienced team members.
   

  

**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Implement, and maintain enterprise and data center network solutions, including routing, switching, security, voice, and load‑balancing technologies.

* Implement and maintain firewall solutions using Palo Alto and/or Check Point technologies, including policy configuration, NAT, VPNs, and platform upgrades.

**Engineering Standards \& Documentation**
* Develop and maintain network documentation, including diagrams, configurations, standards, and guidelines.
* Contribute to network and security capacity planning activities.
* Ensure compliance with Ensono security standards and industry best practices.


**Collaboration \& Customer Engagement**
* Interact and consult with Ensono customers to gather solution requirements.
* Coordinate solutions with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Communicate project status effectively and support client satisfaction measurement.


**Leadership, Ownership \& Strategy**
* Fully functional and self‑directed on assigned work.
* Own high‑complexity and moderate‑complexity assignments; provide oversight and review for low‑complexity work.
* Lead high‑priority technical initiatives or processes.
* Act as a product, technology, or domain Subject Matter Expert (SME) as required.
* Provide formal or informal mentorship to less experienced associates.
* Contribute to product and technology strategy (e.g., Cisco or security platforms), including:
+ Input into product roadmaps and requirements
+ Collaboration with engineering and delivery teams to align strategy with implementation and operational capabilities


**Qualifications**
**Required**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant work experience.
* Strong knowledge of routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP).
* Expertise in switching technologies (VLANs, STP, trunking, EtherChannel).

* Hands‑on experience with firewall technologies (Palo Alto and/or Check Point).
* Experience with load balancers such as F5, Citrix NetScaler, A10, or equivalent.
* Solid understanding of network security principles and best practices.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced, customer‑focused environment.


**Preferred**

* Relevant certifications or equivalent experience in one or more of the following:
+ CCNA, CCNP, CCDP, CCIE
+ Palo Alto (PCNSE)
+ F5 Certification
+ Check Point or other security certifications


**Soft Skills**
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking an experienced Senior Fortinet Network Engineer with 10\+ years of hands\-on expertise in designing, implementing, and managing enterprise\-grade network security infrastructures. The ideal candidate will have deep proficiency in Fortinet's Security Fabric ecosystem, including FortiGate, FortiAnalyzer, FortiManager, and related platforms. This is a fully remote position aligned to US business hours.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, deploy, and manage Fortinet FortiGate firewalls across enterprise and multi\-site environments.

* Design and maintain SD\-WAN solutions leveraging Fortinet's SD\-WAN capabilities for optimized traffic management.

* Collaborate with SOC, cloud, and infrastructure teams to integrate network security with broader enterprise architecture.
* Lead network capacity planning, performance monitoring, and lifecycle management for Fortinet infrastructure.
* Mentor junior engineers and support knowledge transfer within the team.
* Create and maintain detailed network documentation including topology diagrams, runbooks, and change records.
* Participate in on\-call rotation for critical US\-hours incidents as required.



  





**Experience Requirements** 



* Minimum 10 years of overall network engineering experience with at least 5 years focused on Fortinet technologies.
* Proven track record of managing enterprise Fortinet environments with 100\+ FortiGate devices or complex multi\-site deployments.
* Experience working in 24x7 NOC/SOC or managed services environments supporting US\-based clients.
* Prior experience in BFSI, Healthcare, Retail, or Technology verticals is an added advantage.
* Demonstrated ability to handle P1/P2 incidents independently and drive resolution within SLA.
* Strong documentation skills – ability to produce HLD, LLD, and network topology diagrams.

 You will collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Product Managers, and Engineers to design documentation that demystifies machine learning workflows and data analytics. Your goal is to make the sophisticated “brains” of our product accessible, articulating the value of our technology in a clear, concise, and compelling manner.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Documentation Development: Create and maintain high\-quality documentation, including user guides, API references, and release notes, with a specific focus on AI/ML model configurations and data integration workflows
* Conceptual Simplification: Translate intricate concepts such as predictive analytics, neural networks, and data pipelines into digestible content for both technical and non\-technical personas.
* UX \& AI Writing: Review UI strings and chatbot interaction flows to ensure the user experience is intuitive and reflects the intelligence of the platform.
* Technical Accuracy: Work with SMEs to document the logic behind our Decision Skills, ensuring that data schemas and algorithmic outputs are accurately described.
* Content Strategy: Contribute to documentation standards that specifically address the unique needs of a Data Science\-heavy platform.
* Lifecycle Management: Keep pace with rapid sprint cycles, ensuring documentation evolves as our AI models and data capabilities are updated.


**Nice to Have**
* As an experienced Technical Writer with 3\-7 years of dedicated technical writing experience, you should possess the following qualifications and attributes:
* Educational Foundation: Degree in Computer Science, Technical Communication, or a related field, with a demonstrated understanding of Data Science and AI/ML fundamentals.
* Technical Literacy: Ability to read and explain technical architecture, including API structures (REST), JSON, and SQL basics.
* AI/ML Fluency: You must be comfortable discussing concepts like supervised/unsupervised learning, data modeling, and how AI\-driven insights are generated.
* Exceptional Writing: Superior command of English with the ability to explain “the why” behind the data, not just “the how” of the interface.
* Tool Proficiency: Experience with modern documentation stacks (e.g., Markdown, Confluence, Gitbook, or Docs\-as\-Code environments).
* Analytical Mindset: A proactive approach to learning how data flows through a platform to solve complex business problems.


 If you share our passion for building a sustainable, intelligent, and efficient world, you’re in the right place. title: Technical Writer - GIS
description:
**About Us**
 Groundbreaker. Game changer. Pioneer.
   

  

 TRC has long set the bar for clients who require more than just engineering, combining science with the latest technology to devise innovative solutions that stand the test of time. From pipelines to power plants, roadways to reservoirs, schoolyards to security solutions, clients look to TRC for breakthrough thinking backed by the innovative follow\-through of an industry leader.
   

  

 TRC's professionals work with a broad range of commercial, industrial and government clients and the communities they serve. We deliver breakthrough solutions that address local needs \-\- so our clients can better succeed in an ever\-changing world.
   

  

 Working at TRC means tackling interesting, meaningful projects. We pride ourselves on our collaborative spirit, entrepreneurial zeal and agile corporate structure. We recognize that the expertise of our staff is our strongest asset, so we generously reward employees for successful performance and invest in their careers through training and the development of new skills and certifications.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Technical Writer will be responsible for creating and maintaining high\-quality technical documentation for GIS solutions while leveraging their expertise in Esri technologies and solution design.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of GIS consulting, data engineering, and enterprise application integration. The Technical Writer will be responsible for producing high\-quality documentation across all project phases, from discovery and requirements gathering through data migration, integration design, training, and go\-live, ensuring that technical decisions, processes, and outcomes are clearly captured for diverse audiences including GIS analysts, IT administrators, field operations staff, and executive stakeholders.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including user manuals, solution architecture diagrams, workflows, data mapping specifications, schema comparison reports, cutover runbooks and training materials for GIS applications.
* Document discovery workshop outputs covering commodity workflows (Electric, Gas, Water, Fiber), data models, IT landscape, interfaces, and project impacts.
* Work closely with GIS analysts, data engineers, developers, integration architects, stakeholders, and third\-party system vendors to understand technical workflows and translate them into clear, user\-friendly documentation.
* Document Utility Network configuration specifications including domain networks, tier management, subnetwork definitions, and topology rules.
* Produce integration readiness assessments capturing UN\-compatibility evaluations, gap analyses, and backward\-schema mapping requirements and ensure documentation adheres to industry standards and best practices, focusing on accuracy and usability.
* Create visual aids such as diagrams, data flow diagrams, and architecture diagrams and infographics to support written content.
* Create and maintain traceability matrices linking business requirements to technical design decisions across all project phases and organizational goals.
* Develop role\-based training content for multiple user groups and author quick reference guides, step\-by\-step SOPs, and annotated workflow diagrams for post\-migration operations.
* Support Organizational Change Management (OCM) by producing stakeholder communications, FAQs, and change impact summaries throughout the project lifecycle.
* Mentor junior team members in documentation practices and technical writing standards.
* Stay updated on emerging GIS technologies and trends to incorporate relevant information into documentation.
* Support presales and client\-facing activities by preparing technical presentations and proposals.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Computer Science, English, Technical Writing, or a related field.
* 8 to 12 years of experience in technical writing, solution design, or GIS development.
* Expertise \& demonstrated experience documenting ArcGIS platform implementations, preferably ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, or ArcGIS Utility Network.
* Working knowledge of utility operations across at least one commodity domain: Electric, Gas, Water, or Fiber.
* Proven ability to document complex system integrations including API flows, data exchange mechanisms, and enterprise middleware.
* Strong understanding of geospatial concepts, including projections, coordinate systems, and data models.
* Proficiency in tools such as MS Word, Adobe Acrobat, Visio, and diagramming software.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple documentation projects simultaneously.
* Experience in mentoring or leading teams is a plus.


**Nice\-to\-Have (not Mandatory)**
* Prior exposure to ArcFM or Smallworld GIS environments and migration projects.
* Knowledge of ETL concepts, data modelling, and geodatabase schema documentation.
* Experience working in agile or hybrid project delivery environments.
* Familiarity with enterprise systems such as SCADA, OMS, ADMS, AMI, Maximo etc. or similar utility operational platforms.
* Understanding of Organizational Change Management (OCM) frameworks.


 EEO Statement
   

  

 TRC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
   

  

 The complete job description and application are available on TRC’s career site.
   

  

 TRC accepts applications for this position on an ongoing, rolling basis and reserves the right to cancel this posting at any time.

 At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next\-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. description:
**Job Description**
 At Verint, we believe customer engagement is the core of every global brand. Our mission is to help organizations elevate Customer Experience (CX) and increase workforce productivity by delivering CX Automation. We hire innovators with passion, creativity, and drive to answer constantly shifting market challenges and deliver impactful results for our customers. Learn more at www.verint.com.
   

  

**Overview Of Job Function**
 We’re looking for an experienced Senior Technical Writer to join our Engineering organization. In this role, you will work closely with engineers, product managers, architects, and QA teams in a fast‑paced agile environment to deliver content that helps customers use our products with confidence. You’ll break down complex technical concepts and transform them into clear, accurate, and user‑centric documentation that supports a wide range of personas. This role is ideal for a writer who is technically curious, detail‑driven, and passionate about helping users understand how enterprise software works.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Principal Duties and Essential Responsibilities:**
* Own end‑to‑end documentation delivery for assigned product areas, ensuring content is accurate, complete, consistent, and delivered on schedule.
* Partner closely with cross‑functional stakeholders \- including Product Management, Engineering, QA, Architecture, UX and Support \- to gather information, validate accuracy, and deeply understand product / feature capabilities.
* Lead the full content development lifecycle, including scoping, analysis, information architecture, drafting, technical validation, editing, and publication.
* Stay tightly aligned with feature and release development, proactively identifying documentation scope, risks, and dependencies.
* Actively use AI\-assisted tools throughout the documentation authoring lifecycle to accelerate content creation, improve quality, and increase efficiency.
* Drive continuous improvement in documentation quality, focusing on clarity, structure, usability, searchability, and customer value based on feedback and data.
* Contribute to cross‑team initiatives that enhance documentation tooling, templates, workflows, automation, and publishing processes.
* Serve as a documentation lead for complex or cross‑product features, coordinating tasks across writers and ensuring high‑quality, cohesive output.
* Coordinate and facilitate technical and editorial reviews with subject matter experts, ensuring timely feedback and issue resolution.
* Provide peer reviews and mentoring for other content developers, offering guidance on writing quality, structure, consistency, and best practices.
* Monitor and report project progress, escalating risks, blockers, or resource constraints to management as needed.
* Create in app guidance using Pendo to onboard new users to our products and enable them on the latest features.
* Respond to content update requests related to defects, customer feedback, and root‑cause analyses, ensuring documentation remains accurate and current.
* Review and contribute to user interface text, collaborating with UX and Development teams to improve clarity, terminology, and user guidance across the product.


**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**
* 8\+ years of technical writing experience in a large software company, SaaS, or enterprise technology environment.
* Proficiency with industry standard documentation tools and source control, specifically MadCap Flare and GitHub.
* Strong experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, collaborating with PM, Dev, QA, and UX teams.
* Demonstrated experience with structured authoring (e.g. topic\-based writing) and reusable content strategy.
* Knowledge and experience of using AI tools to assist with specific tasks during the content authoring lifecycle.
* Expertise applying style guides, terminology standards, and accessibility guidelines (WCAG or similar).
* Experience reviewing UI text and collaborating on UX writing, aligning terminology and improving user guidance.
* Self‑directed and highly organized, able to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities.
* Detail‑oriented mindset, with a strong focus on accuracy and technical precision.
* Customer‑centric approach, always considering usability and clarity from the end‑user perspective.
* Experience working with global or distributed teams, including navigating multiple time zones and asynchronous collaboration.
* Experience leading documentation efforts for large features or cross‑product initiatives.

title: Senior Technical Proposal Writer
description:
We’re in an unbelievably exciting area of tech and are fundamentally reshaping the data storage industry. Here, you lead with innovative thinking, grow along with us, and join the smartest team in the industry.
   

  

 This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.
   

  

**THE ROLE**
 Pure is seeking a Senior Content Writer with strong enterprise infrastructure expertise to join the Global Value Management team.
   

  

 This role is responsible for developing high\-quality, reusable, modular written content that enables the creation of compelling, enterprise\-grade value propositions, proactive proposals and supporting technical, operational and commercial documentation.
   

  

 You will apply your understanding of enterprise infrastructure architectures to synthesize complex technical, operational and commercial inputs from Product, Engineering, Value Consultants, Competitive Intelligence, CX, Partners and Sales into clear, structured customer narratives that articulate the business value of Pure solutions.
   

  

 As the primary content writer within the team, you will help create and maintain the global master content library that underpins scalable proposal creation. You will enforce written content standards, ensuring outputs are governed, reusable and aligned to established messaging and quality standards.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Build \& Maintain Reusable Content**
* Own writing of defined technical, operational and financial value levers for Pure solutions.
* Develop reusable modular components at multiple levels of detail (executive summary, standard narrative, detailed technical content).
* Create persona and industry aware variations of core narrative where required.
* Consume and adapt existing Pure content (case studies, product documentation, analyst endorsements, services materials) for structured proposal use.
* Maintain and evolve global master content in alignment with roadmap priorities and release cycles.


**Technical and Value Writing**
* Translate technical, operational and financial inputs into clear value narratives.
* Compile and synthesize inputs from cross\-functional SMEs into customer\-ready outputs.
* Independently engage SMEs to validate accuracy and secure approval.
* Balance technical credibility with executive\-level clarity.


**Proposal Content Building**
* Develop best practice placeholder content for: Value propositions, Proactive proposals and Technical/operational/commercial Appendices
* Ensure content demonstrates strong narrative flow, clarity and business value articulation.


**Support Select Engagements**
* Participate in select live proposal engagements to refine standards and identify reusable content opportunities.
* Contribute written content for strategic proactive proposals where required.


**Standards \& Quality**
* Co own content standards \& contribute to QA processes and structured release management for written content.
* Establish clear stakeholder communication and approval protocols.
* Ensure all outputs adhere to messaging, quality and governance requirements.
* We are primarily an in\-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Bangalore office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.


**What You Bring**
**Infrastructure \& Technical Knowledge**
* Strong knowledge of enterprise infrastructure technologies, with demonstrated experience writing about one or more of the following domains: (Enterprise storage (block, file, object), Compute and virtualization platforms, Hybrid cloud architectures, Data center, Infrastructure operations)
* Ability to confidently engage technical SMEs and interpret architectural and operational concepts.
* Experience synthesizing financial concepts into simple narrative form (taking input from SME’s not expected to have financial experience).
* Comfort navigating multi solution portfolios and articulating integrated solution value.


**Writing Expertise**
* Exceptional written English skills, with the ability to produce precise, polished, executive ready content.
* Significant experience writing technical, solution or value\-based content in an enterprise IT environment.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical, operational and commercial inputs into clear, customer facing narrative.
* Experience building reusable, modular content or structured proposal components.
* Strong executive writing skills, including development of compelling summaries and structured appendices.


**Process \& Collaboration**
* Proven ability to work cross functionally with Product, Sales, Marketing, Engineering and Services teams.
* Experience independently driving SME engagement, review cycles and approvals.
* Strong version control, content lifecycle and revision management discipline.


**Preferred**
* Experience supporting enterprise sales or value selling motions.
* Familiarity with proposal development and business case articulation.
* Exposure to modular content systems or AI enabled content tools.
* Experience operating in global organizations with standardized messaging frameworks.


**What You Can Expect From Us**
* Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
* Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
* Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.


 And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company\-sponsored team events. Check out purebenefits.com for more information.
   

  

**Accommodations And Accessibility**
 Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at TA\-Ops@purestorage.com if you’re invited to an interview.
   

  

**Our Commitment To a Strong And Inclusive Team**
 We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.
   

  

 Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.
   

  

**Join us and bring your best.**
**Bring your bold.**
**Pure and simple.**

title: Senior Technical Writer, CX
description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
   

  

**So, what’s the role all about?**
 We’re looking for a Senior Technical Writer to own documentation across our Proactive AI product \- a fast‑growing area within NiCE Cognigy that powers intelligent, autonomous customer interactions at scale.
   

  

 In this role you will create and maintain both internal and external technical documentation: developer‑facing API and CLI references, integration guides, and release notes that enable our customers and partners to build on our platform as well as internal product specifications, architecture guides, used by our own engineering, product, and professional services teams.
   

  

 You’ll be embedded in the product team \- working closely with the engineering team \- to deliver documentation that is accurate, timely, and useful. This is a highly autonomous individual‑contributor role where you own your output end‑to‑end.
   

  

**How will you make an impact?**
* Own end\-to\-end documentation for the Proactive AI product surface, covering both external developer documentation and internal technical content.
* Create and maintain REST API reference documentation \- endpoints, authentication, request/response specs, error codes, and real working examples.
* Develop integration guides and quickstart tutorials that take a developer from zero to a working implementation.
* Maintain internal documentation including product and feature specifications, architecture and data\-flow guides, admin and configuration manuals, and support runbooks.
* Monitor support channels and customer feedback to identify documentation gaps and continuously improve content quality.
* Manage versioning, changelogs, and deprecation notices to keep the docs estate consistent and current.
* Champion documentation best practices and leverage AI tooling \- LLMs and documentation\-specific tools \- to improve quality and throughput.
* Collaborate with the UX team on in\-product microcopy, tooltips, and error messages where needed.


**Have you got what it takes?**
* 5\-7 years of experience as a Technical Writer, with at least 2 years producing developer\-facing or API documentation.
* Proven track record of owning end\-to\-end documentation for complex enterprise software products.
* Strong grasp of REST APIs and developer\-centric documentation \- you can read an OpenAPI spec and turn it into documentation developers actually use.
* Experience using AI tools to assist with documentation workflows, with the ability to validate output and correct inaccuracies.
* Excellent written communication skills \- clear, concise, and always optimised for the reader.
* Highly motivated, organised, and self\-managed, with the ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced environment.


**What’s in it for you?**
 Join an ever\-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast\-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NICE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NICEr!
   

  

**Enjoy NICE\-FLEX!**
 At NICE, we work according to the NICE\-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face\-to\-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

 Individual Contributor
